recommendations.title: Add explicit 'When NOT to use' section
recommendations.problem: Skill documents limits and handoffs but lacks consolidated out-of-scope guidance
recommendations.root_cause: Escape hatch criterion expects explicit 'When NOT to use' signaling
recommendations.fix: Add section after 'Choose Mode': 'When NOT to use: DiffDock confidence scores are not binding affinities (pIC50/Kd); for virtual screening campaigns use orthogonal filters; for multi-conformer receptor ensembles use specialized tools.'
